create_env_object: create an Env object from os.environ or a custom dictionary of environment variables
set_env_variable: set an environment variable key-value pair on an Env object with case-insensitive handling on Windows
add_path_entry: add a directory entry to a PATH-style environment variable by appending or prepending it
add_flag: add a compiler flag to a CXXFLAGS-style environment variable by appending or prepending it
search_path_for_executable: search the PATH in an Env object for an executable like ninja or g++ and return its full path
